title.zh: 英伟达扩充开放模型家族，覆盖语言、机器人、生物医药及量子计算
title.en: 英伟达扩充开放模型家族，覆盖语言、机器人、生物医药及量子计算

current_state.zh: Nvidia expanded its open model family with Nemotron 3.5 language and vision models, the Kumo business-data model, Cosmos world models for robotics, Alpamayo 2 Edge for autonomous driving, BioNeMo RFD4-Proteina for protein design, and the Ising quantum model, targeting European enterprises and researchers building custom applications on self-controlled infrastructure.
